WITH orders_de AS
  (SELECT o.order_date,
          SUM(CASE
                  WHEN o.status != 'cancelled' THEN o.amount
                  ELSE 0
              END) AS gross_revenue
   FROM `pplk8s-lab-001.silver.orders` AS o
   JOIN `pplk8s-lab-001.silver.customers` AS c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id
   WHERE c.country = 'DE'
     AND o.order_date = DATE '2026-10-01'
   GROUP BY o.order_date),
     returns_de AS
  (SELECT r.return_date,
          SUM(r.amount) AS returns_amount
   FROM `pplk8s-lab-001.silver.returns` AS r
   JOIN `pplk8s-lab-001.silver.customers` AS c ON r.customer_id = c.customer_id
   WHERE c.country = 'DE'
     AND r.return_date = DATE '2026-10-01'
   GROUP BY r.return_date)
SELECT COALESCE(o.gross_revenue, 0) AS gross_revenue_eur,
       COALESCE(r.returns_amount, 0) AS returns_eur,
       COALESCE(o.gross_revenue, 0) - COALESCE(r.returns_amount, 0) AS net_revenue_eur
FROM orders_de o
FULL OUTER JOIN returns_de r ON o.order_date = r.return_date;

WITH sep_signups AS
  (SELECT customer_id,
          signup_date
   FROM `pplk8s-lab-001.silver.customers`
   WHERE signup_date >= DATE '2026-09-01'
     AND signup_date <= DATE '2026-09-30' ),
     orders_placed AS

          COUNTIF(o.order_date >= s.signup_date

SELECT COUNT(*) AS total_signups,
       COUNTIF(orders_within_30d > 0) AS customers_ordered_within_30d,

args.sql:
WITH customer_order_counts AS
  (SELECT customer_id,
          COUNT(order_id) AS total_orders
   FROM `pplk8s-lab-001.silver.orders`
   GROUP BY customer_id),
     period_orders AS
  (SELECT o.order_id,
          o.customer_id,
          o.amount,
          o.status,
          coc.total_orders
   FROM `pplk8s-lab-001.silver.orders` AS o
   JOIN customer_order_counts AS coc ON o.customer_id = coc.customer_id
   WHERE o.order_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-10-01' AND DATE '2026-10-10'
     AND LOWER(o.status) != 'cancelled' )
SELECT SUM(CASE
               WHEN total_orders >= 2 THEN amount
               ELSE 0
           END) AS repeat_customer_revenue_eur,
       SUM(amount) AS total_revenue_eur,
       ROUND(SAFE_DIVIDE(SUM(CASE
                                 WHEN total_orders >= 2 THEN amount
                                 ELSE 0
                             END), SUM(amount)) * 100, 2) AS repeat_customer_revenue_percentage
FROM period_orders;

In early October 2026 (October 1 to October 10), the cost per lead for search campaigns was **€46.00**, resulting from €230.00 in total ad spend across 5 leads generated.

WITH spend_data AS

   FROM `pplk8s-lab-001.silver.ad_spend` AS s

turns.text: Based on the lead-to-booking rate definition (leads booking within 30 days of creation), **30.0%** (3 out of 10) of leads created on 1 and 2 October 2026 went on to book.

args.sql:
WITH leads_filtered AS
  (SELECT lead_id,
          created_date,
          created_ts
   FROM `pplk8s-lab-001.silver.leads`
   WHERE created_date IN (DATE '2026-10-01', DATE '2026-10-02') ),
     conversions AS
  (SELECT l.lead_id,
          l.created_date,
          CASE
              WHEN b.booking_id IS NOT NULL
                   AND DATE_DIFF(b.booked_date, l.created_date, DAY) <= 30
                   AND b.booked_date >= l.created_date THEN 1
              ELSE 0
          END AS is_converted
   FROM leads_filtered AS l
   LEFT JOIN `pplk8s-lab-001.silver.bookings` AS b ON l.lead_id = b.lead_id)
SELECT COUNT(lead_id) AS total_leads,
       SUM(is_converted) AS converted_leads,
       ROUND(SAFE_DIVIDE(SUM(is_converted), COUNT(lead_id)) * 100, 2) AS lead_to_booking_percentage,
       SAFE_DIVIDE(SUM(is_converted), COUNT(lead_id)) AS lead_to_booking_rate
FROM conversions;

args.sql:
WITH page_views AS

                   event_date

   WHERE action_type = 'page_view'
     AND channel = 'site'

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT pv.session_id) AS page_view_sessions,

       ROUND(SAFE_DIVIDE(COUNT(DISTINCT ac.session_id), COUNT(DISTINCT pv.session_id)) * 100, 2) AS view_to_cart_percentage,
       SAFE_DIVIDE(COUNT(DISTINCT ac.session_id), COUNT(DISTINCT pv.session_id)) AS view_to_cart_ratio

turns.text: Revenue for the week starting Monday, 14 September 2026 grew by **32.65%** over the previous week (increasing from €2,340.50 to €3,104.75), calculated based on non-cancelled orders and standard week-over-week revenue growth.

args.sql:
WITH weekly_revenue AS
  (SELECT DATE_TRUNC(order_date, WEEK(MONDAY)) AS week_start,
          SUM(amount) AS revenue
   FROM `pplk8s-lab-001.silver.orders`
   WHERE status != 'cancelled'
     AND order_date >= DATE '2026-09-07'
     AND order_date < DATE '2026-09-28'
   GROUP BY week_start)
SELECT current_week.week_start AS current_week_start,
       current_week.revenue AS current_week_revenue,
       previous_week.week_start AS previous_week_start,
       previous_week.revenue AS previous_week_revenue,
       ROUND(SAFE_DIVIDE(current_week.revenue - previous_week.revenue, previous_week.revenue) * 100, 2) AS growth_percentage
FROM weekly_revenue AS current_week
JOIN weekly_revenue AS previous_week ON current_week.week_start = DATE_ADD(previous_week.week_start, INTERVAL 7 DAY)
WHERE current_week.week_start = DATE '2026-09-14'

turns.text: During the week of September 14, 2026, bookings grew by **3** (an increase of **27.27%** week-over-week growth), rising from 11 bookings in the week of September 7 to 14 bookings.

args.sql:
WITH weekly_bookings AS
  (SELECT DATE_TRUNC(booked_date, WEEK(MONDAY)) AS week_start,
          COUNT(booking_id) AS bookings_count
   FROM `pplk8s-lab-001.silver.bookings`
   WHERE booked_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-09-01' AND DATE '2026-09-30'
   GROUP BY week_start)
SELECT curr.week_start AS current_week,
       curr.bookings_count AS current_week_bookings,
       prev.week_start AS previous_week,
       prev.bookings_count AS previous_week_bookings,
       curr.bookings_count - prev.bookings_count AS bookings_growth,
       ROUND(SAFE_DIVIDE(curr.bookings_count - prev.bookings_count, prev.bookings_count) * 100, 2) AS bookings_wow_growth_pct
FROM weekly_bookings AS curr
LEFT JOIN weekly_bookings AS prev ON prev.week_start = DATE_SUB(curr.week_start, INTERVAL 1 WEEK)
WHERE curr.week_start = DATE '2026-09-14'
ORDER BY current_week;

turns.text: For the week starting 14 September 2026, the week-over-week growth in leads was **20.69%** (a growth ratio of ~0.207), increasing from 29 leads in the prior week to 35 leads, based on Leads week-over-week growth.

args.sql:
WITH weekly_leads AS
  (SELECT DATE_TRUNC(created_date, WEEK(MONDAY)) AS week_start,
          COUNT(lead_id) AS total_leads
   FROM `pplk8s-lab-001.silver.leads`
   WHERE created_date >= '2026-09-01'
     AND created_date <= '2026-09-30'
   GROUP BY week_start),
     growth_calc AS
  (SELECT week_start,
          total_leads AS leads,
          LAG(total_leads) OVER (
                                 ORDER BY week_start) AS previous_week_leads,
                                SAFE_DIVIDE(total_leads - LAG(total_leads) OVER (
                                                                                 ORDER BY week_start), LAG(total_leads) OVER (
                                                                                                                              ORDER BY week_start)) AS leads_wow_growth_ratio,
                                ROUND(SAFE_DIVIDE(total_leads - LAG(total_leads) OVER (
                                                                                       ORDER BY week_start), LAG(total_leads) OVER (
                                                                                                                                    ORDER BY week_start)) * 100, 2) AS leads_wow_growth_pct
   FROM weekly_leads)
SELECT week_start,
       leads,
       previous_week_leads,
       leads_wow_growth_ratio,
       leads_wow_growth_pct
FROM growth_calc
WHERE week_start = DATE '2026-09-14'

turns.text: Net revenue is defined as **Revenue (EUR) minus partner returns (EUR)**. ### Calculation Breakdown: 1. **Gross Revenue (€981.69):** Sum of order amounts for all non-cancelled orders placed on `2026-10-01` from `silver.orders`. 2. **Partner Returns (€17.50):** Sum of return amounts recorded on `return_date = '2026-10-01'` from `silver.returns`. 3. **Net Revenue (€964.19):** `€981.69 - €17.50 = €964.19`. ```sql WITH revenue AS ( SELECT COALESCE(SUM(amount), 0) AS gross_revenue_eur FROM `pplk8s-lab-001.silver.orders` WHERE order_date = DATE '2026-10-01' AND LOWER(status) != 'cancelled' ), returns_data AS ( SELECT COALESCE(SUM(amount), 0) AS returns_eur FROM `pplk8s-lab-001.silver.returns` WHERE return_date = DATE '2026-10-01' ) SELECT revenue.gross_revenue_eur, returns_data.returns_eur, revenue.gross_revenue_eur - returns_data.returns_eur AS net_revenue_eur FROM revenue CROSS JOIN returns_data ```

WITH spend_by_channel AS
  (SELECT c.channel,
          SUM(s.spend) AS total_spend_eur
   FROM `pplk8s-lab-001.silver.ad_spend` AS s
   JOIN `pplk8s-lab-001.silver.campaigns` AS c ON s.campaign_id = c.campaign_id
   WHERE s.spend_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-08-17' AND DATE '2026-10-02'
   GROUP BY c.channel),
     leads_by_channel AS
  (SELECT c.channel,
          COUNT(l.lead_id) AS total_leads
   FROM `pplk8s-lab-001.silver.leads` AS l
   JOIN `pplk8s-lab-001.silver.campaigns` AS c ON l.campaign_id = c.campaign_id
   WHERE l.created_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-08-17' AND DATE '2026-10-02'
   GROUP BY c.channel)
SELECT COALESCE(s.channel, l.channel) AS channel,
       COALESCE(s.total_spend_eur, 0) AS total_spend_eur,
       COALESCE(l.total_leads, 0) AS total_leads,
       ROUND(SAFE_DIVIDE(COALESCE(s.total_spend_eur, 0), l.total_leads), 2) AS cost_per_lead_eur
FROM spend_by_channel AS s
FULL OUTER JOIN leads_by_channel AS l ON s.channel = l.channel
ORDER BY cost_per_lead_eur ASC

          TIMESTAMP_DIFF(MAX(event_ts), MIN(event_ts), SECOND) / 60.0 AS duration_minutes

turns.text: On 1 October 2026, the net revenue was **€964.19**, computed as **€981.69** in gross revenue (from non-cancelled orders) minus **€17.50** in partner returns.

args.sql:
WITH daily_revenue AS
  (SELECT order_date AS sales_date,
          SUM(amount) AS revenue_eur
   FROM `pplk8s-lab-001.silver.orders`
   WHERE status != 'cancelled'
     AND order_date = DATE '2026-10-01'
   GROUP BY order_date),
     daily_returns AS
  (SELECT return_date AS sales_date,
          SUM(amount) AS returns_eur
   FROM `pplk8s-lab-001.silver.returns`
   WHERE return_date = DATE '2026-10-01'
   GROUP BY return_date)
SELECT DATE '2026-10-01' AS date,
       COALESCE(r.revenue_eur, 0) AS revenue_eur,
       COALESCE(ret.returns_eur, 0) AS returns_eur,
       COALESCE(r.revenue_eur, 0) - COALESCE(ret.returns_eur, 0) AS net_revenue_eur
FROM
  (SELECT DATE '2026-10-01' AS d) d
LEFT JOIN daily_revenue r ON d.d = r.sales_date
LEFT JOIN daily_returns ret ON d.d = ret.sales_date;

args.sql:
WITH weekly_revenue AS
  (SELECT DATE_TRUNC(order_date, WEEK(MONDAY)) AS week_start,
          SUM(amount) AS revenue_eur
   FROM `pplk8s-lab-001.silver.orders`
   WHERE status != 'cancelled'
     AND order_date >= DATE '2026-09-07'
     AND order_date < DATE '2026-09-28'
   GROUP BY week_start)
SELECT curr.week_start AS week_starting,
       prev.revenue_eur AS previous_week_revenue_eur,
       curr.revenue_eur AS current_week_revenue_eur,
       curr.revenue_eur - prev.revenue_eur AS revenue_change_eur,
       ROUND(SAFE_DIVIDE(curr.revenue_eur - prev.revenue_eur, prev.revenue_eur) * 100, 2) AS revenue_growth_percentage
FROM weekly_revenue AS curr
INNER JOIN weekly_revenue AS prev ON prev.week_start = DATE_SUB(curr.week_start, INTERVAL 7 DAY)
WHERE curr.week_start = DATE '2026-09-14';

   GROUP BY 1),
     growth_calc AS
  (SELECT week_start_date,
          bookings_count,
          LAG(bookings_count) OVER (
                                    ORDER BY week_start_date) AS prev_week_bookings,
                                   bookings_count - LAG(bookings_count) OVER (
                                                                              ORDER BY week_start_date) AS bookings_growth,

       COALESCE(o.gross_revenue, 0) - COALESCE(r.returns_amount, 0) AS net_revenue_eur
FROM daily_orders o
FULL OUTER JOIN daily_returns r ON o.order_date = r.return_date;

turns.text: Based on the definition of Net revenue (EUR), the figure was calculated as **Revenue (EUR)** minus **Returns (EUR)** recorded on 1 October 2026: 1. **Gross Revenue (€981.69):** Sum of order amounts for all non-cancelled orders placed on `2026-10-01` (`silver.orders` where `status != 'cancelled'`). 2. **Returns (€17.50):** Sum of partner return amounts recorded on `2026-10-01` (`silver.returns` where `return_date = '2026-10-01'`). 3. **Net Revenue (€964.19):** `€981.69 - €17.50 = €964.19`. ### SQL Query Used ```sql WITH daily_orders AS ( SELECT order_date, SUM(amount) AS gross_revenue FROM `pplk8s-lab-001.silver.orders` WHERE order_date = '2026-10-01' AND status != 'cancelled' GROUP BY order_date ), daily_returns AS ( SELECT return_date, SUM(amount) AS returns_amount FROM `pplk8s-lab-001.silver.returns` WHERE return_date = '2026-10-01' GROUP BY return_date ) SELECT COALESCE(o.order_date, r.return_date) AS date, COALESCE(o.gross_revenue, 0) AS revenue_eur, COALESCE(r.returns_amount, 0) AS returns_eur, COALESCE(o.gross_revenue, 0) - COALESCE(r.returns_amount, 0) AS net_revenue_eur FROM daily_orders o FULL OUTER JOIN daily_returns r ON o.order_date = r.return_date; ```

turns.text: Between 17 August and 10 October 2026, the average non-cancelled order amount for customers who signed up before 2026 was **€102.67**, compared to **€41.00** for customers who signed up in 2026, making it **€61.67 higher** (or exactly **€61.666263158**).

WITH order_data AS
  (SELECT o.order_id,
          o.amount,
          c.signup_date,
          CASE
              WHEN c.signup_date < DATE '2026-01-01' THEN 'Pre-2026 Cohort'
              WHEN c.signup_date >= DATE '2026-01-01'
                   AND c.signup_date < DATE '2027-01-01' THEN '2026 Cohort'
              ELSE 'Other'
          END AS cohort_group
   FROM `pplk8s-lab-001.silver.orders` AS o
   JOIN `pplk8s-lab-001.silver.customers` AS c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id
   WHERE o.order_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-08-17' AND DATE '2026-10-10'
     AND LOWER(o.status) != 'cancelled' ),
     cohort_metrics AS
  (SELECT cohort_group,
          COUNT(order_id) AS order_count,
          SUM(amount) AS total_revenue,
          AVG(amount) AS avg_order_value
   FROM order_data
   WHERE cohort_group IN ('Pre-2026 Cohort',
                          '2026 Cohort')
   GROUP BY cohort_group)
SELECT MAX(CASE
               WHEN cohort_group = 'Pre-2026 Cohort' THEN avg_order_value
           END) AS avg_order_value_pre_2026,
       MAX(CASE
               WHEN cohort_group = '2026 Cohort' THEN avg_order_value
           END) AS avg_order_value_2026,
       MAX(CASE
               WHEN cohort_group = 'Pre-2026 Cohort' THEN avg_order_value
           END) - MAX(CASE
                          WHEN cohort_group = '2026 Cohort' THEN avg_order_value
                      END) AS difference_eur
FROM cohort_metrics;

args.sql:
WITH daily_spend AS
  (SELECT spend_date,
          FORMAT_DATE('%A', spend_date) AS day_of_week,

          SUM(spend) AS total_daily_spend
   FROM `pplk8s-lab-001.silver.ad_spend`

       COUNT(DISTINCT spend_date) AS days_count,

FROM daily_spend
GROUP BY day_of_week,
         day_of_week_num
ORDER BY avg_daily_ad_spend_eur DESC,
         day_of_week_num

WITH session_events AS
  (SELECT session_id,
          MIN(CASE
                  WHEN action_type = 'add_to_cart' THEN event_ts

          MIN(CASE
                  WHEN action_type = 'checkout' THEN event_ts
              END) AS first_checkout_ts
   FROM `pplk8s-lab-001.silver.customer_actions`
   WHERE event_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-09-20' AND DATE '2026-10-03'
     AND session_id IS NOT NULL
   GROUP BY session_id
   HAVING first_add_to_cart_ts IS NOT NULL
   AND first_checkout_ts IS NOT NULL),
     session_diffs AS
  (SELECT session_id,
          TIMESTAMP_DIFF(first_checkout_ts, first_add_to_cart_ts, MINUTE) AS minutes_diff,

   FROM session_events)
SELECT COUNT(*) AS total_qualifying_sessions,
       APPROX_QUANTILES(minutes_diff, 2)[OFFSET(1)] AS median_minutes,
       APPROX_QUANTILES(minutes_diff_exact, 2)[OFFSET(1)] AS median_minutes_exact
FROM session_diffs;

WITH customer_order_counts AS
  (SELECT customer_id,
          COUNT(order_id) AS total_orders_all_time,
          COUNTIF(LOWER(status) != 'cancelled') AS valid_orders_all_time
   FROM `pplk8s-lab-001.silver.orders`
   GROUP BY customer_id),
     period_orders AS
  (SELECT o.order_id,
          o.customer_id,

          o.amount,
          o.status,
          c.total_orders_all_time,
          c.valid_orders_all_time

     AND LOWER(o.status) != 'cancelled' )
SELECT SUM(amount) AS total_revenue_eur,
       SUM(CASE
               WHEN total_orders_all_time >= 2 THEN amount
               ELSE 0
           END) AS repeat_revenue_all_orders_eur,
       SUM(CASE
               WHEN valid_orders_all_time >= 2 THEN amount
               ELSE 0
           END) AS repeat_revenue_valid_orders_eur,
       ROUND(SAFE_DIVIDE(SUM(CASE
                                 WHEN total_orders_all_time >= 2 THEN amount
                                 ELSE 0
                             END), SUM(amount)) * 100, 2) AS repeat_revenue_share_all_orders_pct,
       ROUND(SAFE_DIVIDE(SUM(CASE
                                 WHEN valid_orders_all_time >= 2 THEN amount
                                 ELSE 0

args.sql:
WITH search_campaigns AS
  (SELECT campaign_id
   FROM `pplk8s-lab-001.silver.campaigns`
   WHERE LOWER(channel) = 'search' ),
     spend_oct AS
  (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(s.spend), 0) AS total_spend
   FROM `pplk8s-lab-001.silver.ad_spend` AS s
   INNER JOIN search_campaigns AS c ON s.campaign_id = c.campaign_id
   WHERE s.spend_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-10-01' AND DATE '2026-10-10' ),
     leads_oct AS
  (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT l.lead_id) AS total_leads
   FROM `pplk8s-lab-001.silver.leads` AS l
   INNER JOIN search_campaigns AS c ON l.campaign_id = c.campaign_id
   WHERE l.created_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-10-01' AND DATE '2026-10-10' ),
     daily_breakdown AS
  (SELECT d.spend_date,
          COALESCE(s.spend, 0) AS spend,
          COALESCE(l.leads_count, 0) AS leads
   FROM
     (SELECT DISTINCT spend_date
      FROM `pplk8s-lab-001.silver.ad_spend`
      WHERE spend_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-10-01' AND DATE '2026-10-10'
      UNION DISTINCT SELECT DISTINCT created_date
      FROM `pplk8s-lab-001.silver.leads`
      WHERE created_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-10-01' AND DATE '2026-10-10' ) AS d
   LEFT JOIN
     (SELECT s.spend_date,
             SUM(s.spend) AS spend
      FROM `pplk8s-lab-001.silver.ad_spend` AS s
      INNER JOIN search_campaigns AS c ON s.campaign_id = c.campaign_id
      WHERE s.spend_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-10-01' AND DATE '2026-10-10'
      GROUP BY s.spend_date) AS s ON d.spend_date = s.spend_date
   LEFT JOIN
     (SELECT l.created_date,
             COUNT(DISTINCT l.lead_id) AS leads_count
      FROM `pplk8s-lab-001.silver.leads` AS l
      INNER JOIN search_campaigns AS c ON l.campaign_id = c.campaign_id
      WHERE l.created_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-10-01' AND DATE '2026-10-10'
      GROUP BY l.created_date) AS l ON d.spend_date = l.created_date)
SELECT so.total_spend AS search_ad_spend_eur,
       lo.total_leads AS search_leads,
       ROUND(SAFE_DIVIDE(so.total_spend, lo.total_leads), 2) AS cost_per_lead_eur
FROM spend_oct AS so
CROSS JOIN leads_oct AS lo;

args.sql:
WITH leads_oct AS
  (SELECT l.lead_id,
          l.created_date,
          b.booking_id,
          b.booked_date,
          CASE
              WHEN b.booking_id IS NOT NULL
                   AND DATE_DIFF(b.booked_date, l.created_date, DAY) BETWEEN 0 AND 30 THEN 1
              ELSE 0
          END AS is_booked_within_30d
   FROM `pplk8s-lab-001.silver.leads` AS l
   LEFT JOIN `pplk8s-lab-001.silver.bookings` AS b ON l.lead_id = b.lead_id
   WHERE l.created_date IN ('2026-10-01',
                            '2026-10-02') )
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT lead_id) AS total_leads,
       COUNT(DISTINCT CASE
                          WHEN is_booked_within_30d = 1 THEN lead_id
                      END) AS booked_leads,
       ROUND(SAFE_DIVIDE(COUNT(DISTINCT CASE
                                            WHEN is_booked_within_30d = 1 THEN lead_id
                                        END), COUNT(DISTINCT lead_id)) * 100, 2) AS lead_to_booking_percentage,
       SAFE_DIVIDE(COUNT(DISTINCT CASE
                                      WHEN is_booked_within_30d = 1 THEN lead_id
                                  END), COUNT(DISTINCT lead_id)) AS lead_to_booking_ratio
FROM leads_oct

args.sql:
WITH weekly_revenue AS
  (SELECT DATE_TRUNC(orders.order_date, WEEK(MONDAY)) AS week_start,
          SUM(orders.amount) AS revenue_eur
   FROM `pplk8s-lab-001`.`silver`.`orders` AS orders

     AND orders.order_date >= DATE '2026-09-07'
     AND orders.order_date < DATE '2026-09-21'
   GROUP BY week_start),
     weeks AS

          revenue_eur,

                                 ORDER BY week_start) AS prev_week_revenue
   FROM weekly_revenue)
SELECT week_start,
       revenue_eur AS current_week_revenue,
       prev_week_revenue,
       ROUND(SAFE_DIVIDE(revenue_eur - prev_week_revenue, prev_week_revenue) * 100, 2) AS revenue_growth_percentage
FROM weeks
WHERE week_start = DATE '2026-09-14';

turns.text: The net revenue of **€964.19** on 1 October 2026 was calculated in accordance with the metric definition **Net revenue (EUR) = Revenue (EUR) − Returns (EUR)**: 1. **Revenue (EUR) (€981.69):** The sum of `amount` from `pplk8s-lab-001.silver.orders` for all non-cancelled orders (`status != 'cancelled'`) placed on `order_date = '2026-10-01'`. 2. **Returns (EUR) (€17.50):** The sum of `amount` from `pplk8s-lab-001.silver.returns` for all partner returns recorded on `return_date = '2026-10-01'`. 3. **Net Revenue:** `€981.69 − €17.50 = €964.19`. ### SQL Query Used ```sql WITH rev AS ( SELECT COALESCE(SUM(amount), 0) AS revenue_eur FROM `pplk8s-lab-001.silver.orders` WHERE order_date = '2026-10-01' AND status != 'cancelled' ), ret AS ( SELECT COALESCE(SUM(amount), 0) AS returns_eur FROM `pplk8s-lab-001.silver.returns` WHERE return_date = '2026-10-01' ) SELECT rev.revenue_eur, ret.returns_eur, rev.revenue_eur - ret.returns_eur AS net_revenue_eur FROM rev CROSS JOIN ret; ```

WITH sep_applicants AS
  (SELECT candidate_id,
          applied_date,
          current_stage
   FROM `pplk8s-lab-001.silver.applications`
   WHERE applied_date >= '2026-09-01'
     AND applied_date <= '2026-09-30' ),
     stages_reached AS
  (SELECT a.candidate_id,
          LOGICAL_OR(LOWER(cs.stage) IN ('interview', 'offer', 'hired')
                     OR LOWER(a.current_stage) IN ('interview', 'offer', 'hired')) AS reached_interview_or_beyond
   FROM sep_applicants AS a
   LEFT JOIN `pplk8s-lab-001.silver.candidate_stages` AS cs ON a.candidate_id = cs.candidate_id
   GROUP BY a.candidate_id)
SELECT COUNT(*) AS total_applicants_sep_2026,
       COUNTIF(reached_interview_or_beyond) AS applicants_reached_interview_or_beyond,
       ROUND(SAFE_DIVIDE(COUNTIF(reached_interview_or_beyond), COUNT(*)) * 100, 2) AS share_percentage
FROM stages_reached;

turns.text: For sessions between 20 September and 3 October 2026 that had both an add-to-cart and a checkout, the median duration from the first add-to-cart to the checkout was **4 minutes**.

args.sql:
WITH session_events AS
  (SELECT session_id,
          MIN(CASE
                  WHEN action_type = 'add_to_cart' THEN event_ts
              END) AS first_add_to_cart_ts,
          MIN(CASE
                  WHEN action_type = 'checkout' THEN event_ts
              END) AS first_checkout_ts
   FROM `pplk8s-lab-001.silver.customer_actions`
   WHERE session_id IS NOT NULL
     AND event_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-09-20' AND DATE '2026-10-03'
   GROUP BY session_id
   HAVING first_add_to_cart_ts IS NOT NULL
   AND first_checkout_ts IS NOT NULL),
     session_diffs AS
  (SELECT session_id,
          TIMESTAMP_DIFF(first_checkout_ts, first_add_to_cart_ts, MINUTE) AS minutes_diff,
          TIMESTAMP_DIFF(first_checkout_ts, first_add_to_cart_ts, SECOND) / 60.0 AS exact_minutes_diff
   FROM session_events)
SELECT APPROX_QUANTILES(minutes_diff, 2)[OFFSET(1)] AS median_minutes_integer,
       APPROX_QUANTILES(exact_minutes_diff, 2)[OFFSET(1)] AS median_minutes_exact,
       COUNT(*) AS total_sessions
FROM session_diffs;

turns.text: On 1 October 2026, net revenue was **€964.19**, calculated from **€981.69** in gross revenue (non-cancelled orders) minus **€17.50** in partner returns.

args.sql:
WITH daily_orders AS
  (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(amount), 0) AS gross_revenue
   FROM `pplk8s-lab-001.silver.orders`
   WHERE order_date = DATE '2026-10-01'
     AND status != 'cancelled' ),
     daily_returns AS
  (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(amount), 0) AS returns_amount
   FROM `pplk8s-lab-001.silver.returns`
   WHERE return_date = DATE '2026-10-01' )
SELECT DATE '2026-10-01' AS sales_date,
       o.gross_revenue,
       r.returns_amount,
       (o.gross_revenue - r.returns_amount) AS net_revenue
FROM daily_orders AS o
CROSS JOIN daily_returns AS r

     AND LOWER(status) != 'cancelled' ),
     ret AS

WITH sep_customers AS
  (SELECT customer_id,
          signup_date
   FROM `pplk8s-lab-001.silver.customers`

          COUNT(CASE
                    WHEN o.order_date BETWEEN c.signup_date AND DATE_ADD(c.signup_date, INTERVAL 29 DAY) THEN o.order_id
                END) AS orders_within_30d_all,
          COUNT(CASE
                    WHEN o.order_date BETWEEN c.signup_date AND DATE_ADD(c.signup_date, INTERVAL 29 DAY)
                         AND o.status != 'cancelled' THEN o.order_id
                END) AS orders_within_30d_non_cancelled,
          COUNT(CASE
                    WHEN DATE_DIFF(o.order_date, c.signup_date, DAY) BETWEEN 0 AND 30 THEN o.order_id
                END) AS orders_within_30_diff
   FROM sep_customers c

   GROUP BY c.customer_id,
            c.signup_date)
SELECT COUNT(*) AS total_signups,
       COUNTIF(orders_within_30d_all > 0) AS customers_ordered_within_30d,
       ROUND(COUNTIF(orders_within_30d_all > 0) / COUNT(*) * 100, 2) AS signup_to_first_order_pct_all,

turns.text: Revenue in the week starting Monday 14 September 2026 grew by **32.65%** (€764.25) over the previous week, increasing from €2,340.50 to €3,104.75, based on non-cancelled order revenue and standard week-over-week growth.

args.sql:
WITH weekly_revenue AS
  (SELECT CASE
              WHEN order_date BETWEEN '2026-09-07' AND '2026-09-13' THEN 'Previous Week (Sep 07 - Sep 13)'
              WHEN order_date BETWEEN '2026-09-14' AND '2026-09-20' THEN 'Current Week (Sep 14 - Sep 20)'
          END AS week_period,
          SUM(amount) AS revenue_eur
   FROM `pplk8s-lab-001.silver.orders`
   WHERE status != 'cancelled'
     AND order_date BETWEEN '2026-09-07' AND '2026-09-20'
   GROUP BY week_period)
SELECT prev.revenue_eur AS previous_week_revenue_eur,
       curr.revenue_eur AS current_week_revenue_eur,
       curr.revenue_eur - prev.revenue_eur AS revenue_growth_eur,
       ROUND(SAFE_DIVIDE(curr.revenue_eur - prev.revenue_eur, prev.revenue_eur) * 100, 2) AS growth_percentage
FROM
  (SELECT revenue_eur
   FROM weekly_revenue
   WHERE week_period = 'Previous Week (Sep 07 - Sep 13)') AS prev
CROSS JOIN
  (SELECT revenue_eur
   FROM weekly_revenue
   WHERE week_period = 'Current Week (Sep 14 - Sep 20)') AS curr;

turns.text: In the week of 14 September 2026, bookings grew by **3** (or **27.3%**) compared to the previous week, increasing from **11** bookings (week of 7 September 2026) to **14** bookings based on the week-over-week growth definition.

args.sql:
WITH weekly_bookings AS
  (SELECT DATE_TRUNC(booked_date, WEEK(MONDAY)) AS week_start,
          COUNT(booking_id) AS total_bookings
   FROM `pplk8s-lab-001.silver.bookings`
   WHERE booked_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-09-07' AND DATE '2026-09-20'
   GROUP BY week_start)
SELECT w1.week_start AS current_week,
       w1.total_bookings AS current_week_bookings,
       w0.week_start AS previous_week,
       w0.total_bookings AS previous_week_bookings,
       w1.total_bookings - w0.total_bookings AS absolute_growth,
       ROUND(SAFE_DIVIDE(w1.total_bookings - w0.total_bookings, w0.total_bookings) * 100, 1) AS bookings_wow_growth_pct
FROM weekly_bookings w1
LEFT JOIN weekly_bookings w0 ON w0.week_start = DATE_SUB(w1.week_start, INTERVAL 1 WEEK)
WHERE w1.week_start = DATE '2026-09-14';

turns.text: For the week starting 14 September 2026, the week-over-week growth in leads was **20.7%** (or a growth ratio of **0.207**), increasing from 29 leads the previous week to 35 leads.

args.sql:
WITH weekly_leads AS
  (SELECT DATE_TRUNC(created_date, WEEK(MONDAY)) AS week_start,
          COUNT(lead_id) AS leads
   FROM `pplk8s-lab-001`.`silver`.`leads`
   WHERE created_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-09-01' AND DATE '2026-09-28'
   GROUP BY week_start),
     growth_calc AS
  (SELECT week_start,
          leads,
          LAG(leads) OVER (
                           ORDER BY week_start) AS prev_week_leads,
                          SAFE_DIVIDE(leads - LAG(leads) OVER (
                                                               ORDER BY week_start), LAG(leads) OVER (
                                                                                                      ORDER BY week_start)) AS wow_growth_ratio,
                          ROUND(SAFE_DIVIDE(leads - LAG(leads) OVER (
                                                                     ORDER BY week_start), LAG(leads) OVER (
                                                                                                            ORDER BY week_start)) * 100, 1) AS wow_growth_pct
   FROM weekly_leads)
SELECT week_start,
       leads,
       prev_week_leads,
       wow_growth_ratio,
       wow_growth_pct
FROM growth_calc
WHERE week_start = DATE '2026-09-14';

args.sql:
WITH cohort_orders AS
  (SELECT CASE
              WHEN c.signup_date < '2026-01-01' THEN 'Before 2026'
              WHEN c.signup_date >= '2026-01-01'
                   AND c.signup_date <= '2026-12-31' THEN 'In 2026'
              ELSE 'Other'
          END AS signup_cohort,
          o.amount
   FROM `pplk8s-lab-001.silver.orders` AS o
   JOIN `pplk8s-lab-001.silver.customers` AS c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id
   WHERE o.order_date BETWEEN '2026-08-17' AND '2026-10-10'
     AND LOWER(o.status) != 'cancelled' ),
     cohort_stats AS
  (SELECT signup_cohort,
          COUNT(*) AS total_orders,
          SUM(amount) AS total_revenue,
          AVG(amount) AS avg_order_amount
   FROM cohort_orders
   WHERE signup_cohort IN ('Before 2026',
                           'In 2026')
   GROUP BY signup_cohort)
SELECT max(CASE
               WHEN signup_cohort = 'Before 2026' THEN avg_order_amount
           END) AS avg_amount_before_2026,
       max(CASE
               WHEN signup_cohort = 'In 2026' THEN avg_order_amount
           END) AS avg_amount_in_2026,
       max(CASE
               WHEN signup_cohort = 'Before 2026' THEN avg_order_amount
           END) - max(CASE
                          WHEN signup_cohort = 'In 2026' THEN avg_order_amount
                      END) AS difference_eur
FROM cohort_stats

turns.text: For outreach messages sent between 20 September and 3 October 2026 that received a reply, the **75th percentile of response time** is **10 hours** using continuous interpolation (`PERCENTILE_CONT`) and **7 hours** discrete (`PERCENTILE_DISC`), across the 4 replied messages (individual response times: 2, 6, 7, and 19 hours).

args.sql:
WITH message_diffs AS
  (SELECT message_id,
          sent_ts,
          first_replied_ts,
          TIMESTAMP_DIFF(first_replied_ts, sent_ts, HOUR) AS diff_hours
   FROM `pplk8s-lab-001.silver.outreach_messages`
   WHERE sent_date BETWEEN '2026-09-20' AND '2026-10-03'
     AND first_replied_ts IS NOT NULL )
SELECT PERCENTILE_CONT(diff_hours, 0.75) OVER() AS p75_hours_continuous,
       PERCENTILE_DISC(diff_hours, 0.75) OVER() AS p75_hours_discrete,
       COUNT(*) OVER() AS total_replied_messages
FROM message_diffs
LIMIT 1

args.sql:
WITH cohort AS
  (SELECT customer_id,
          signup_date
   FROM `pplk8s-lab-001.silver.customers`
   WHERE signup_date >= '2026-09-01'
     AND signup_date <= '2026-09-30' ),
     cohort_orders AS
  (SELECT c.customer_id,
          c.signup_date,
          MIN(o.order_date) AS first_order_date,
          COUNT(DISTINCT CASE
                             WHEN DATE_DIFF(o.order_date, c.signup_date, DAY) BETWEEN 0 AND 29 THEN o.order_id
                         END) AS orders_within_30d,
          COUNT(DISTINCT CASE
                             WHEN o.status != 'cancelled'
                                  AND DATE_DIFF(o.order_date, c.signup_date, DAY) BETWEEN 0 AND 29 THEN o.order_id
                         END) AS non_cancelled_orders_within_30d
   FROM cohort c
   LEFT JOIN `pplk8s-lab-001.silver.orders` o ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id
   GROUP BY c.customer_id,
            c.signup_date)
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT customer_id) AS total_signups,
       COUNT(DISTINCT CASE
                          WHEN orders_within_30d > 0 THEN customer_id
                      END) AS customers_with_order_within_30d,
       ROUND(SAFE_DIVIDE(COUNT(DISTINCT CASE
                                            WHEN orders_within_30d > 0 THEN customer_id
                                        END), COUNT(DISTINCT customer_id)) * 100, 2) AS signup_to_first_order_pct,
       COUNT(DISTINCT CASE
                          WHEN non_cancelled_orders_within_30d > 0 THEN customer_id
                      END) AS customers_with_non_cancelled_order_within_30d,
       ROUND(SAFE_DIVIDE(COUNT(DISTINCT CASE
                                            WHEN non_cancelled_orders_within_30d > 0 THEN customer_id
                                        END), COUNT(DISTINCT customer_id)) * 100, 2) AS non_cancelled_signup_to_first_order_pct
FROM cohort_orders;

WITH weekly_revenue AS

args.sql:
WITH order_metrics AS
  (SELECT CASE
              WHEN c.signup_date < DATE '2026-01-01' THEN 'Before 2026'
              WHEN c.signup_date >= DATE '2026-01-01'
                   AND c.signup_date < DATE '2027-01-01' THEN 'In 2026'
              ELSE 'Other'
          END AS signup_cohort,
          AVG(o.amount) AS avg_order_amount,
          SUM(o.amount) AS total_revenue,
          COUNT(o.order_id) AS order_count
   FROM `pplk8s-lab-001.silver.orders` AS o
   INNER JOIN `pplk8s-lab-001.silver.customers` AS c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id
   WHERE o.order_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-08-17' AND DATE '2026-10-10'
     AND LOWER(o.status) != 'cancelled'
   GROUP BY signup_cohort)
SELECT MAX(CASE
               WHEN signup_cohort = 'Before 2026' THEN avg_order_amount
           END) AS avg_aov_before_2026,
       MAX(CASE
               WHEN signup_cohort = 'In 2026' THEN avg_order_amount
           END) AS avg_aov_in_2026,
       MAX(CASE
               WHEN signup_cohort = 'Before 2026' THEN avg_order_amount
           END) - MAX(CASE
                          WHEN signup_cohort = 'In 2026' THEN avg_order_amount
                      END) AS difference_eur
FROM order_metrics;

WITH session_events AS
  (SELECT session_id,
          MIN(CASE
                  WHEN action_type = 'add_to_cart' THEN event_ts
              END) AS first_cart_ts,
          MIN(CASE
                  WHEN action_type = 'checkout' THEN event_ts
              END) AS checkout_ts
   FROM `pplk8s-lab-001.silver.customer_actions`
   WHERE event_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-09-20' AND DATE '2026-10-03'
     AND session_id IS NOT NULL
   GROUP BY session_id
   HAVING MIN(CASE
                  WHEN action_type = 'add_to_cart' THEN event_ts
              END) IS NOT NULL

               WHEN action_type = 'checkout' THEN event_ts
           END) IS NOT NULL),

          TIMESTAMP_DIFF(checkout_ts, first_cart_ts, MINUTE) AS minutes_diff,
          TIMESTAMP_DIFF(checkout_ts, first_cart_ts, SECOND) / 60.0 AS minutes_float
   FROM session_events
   WHERE checkout_ts >= first_cart_ts )
SELECT COUNT(*) AS total_sessions,
       APPROX_QUANTILES(minutes_diff, 2)[OFFSET(1)] AS median_minutes_int,
       APPROX_QUANTILES(minutes_float, 2)[OFFSET(1)] AS median_minutes_float

Based on the Signup-to-first-order rate definition, **33.33%** (3 out of 9) of customers who signed up in September 2026 placed their first order within 30 days of signing up.

args.sql:
WITH sep_cohort AS
  (SELECT customer_id,
          signup_date
   FROM `pplk8s-lab-001.silver.customers`
   WHERE signup_date >= DATE '2026-09-01'
     AND signup_date <= DATE '2026-09-30' ),
     first_orders AS
  (SELECT customer_id,
          MIN(order_date) AS first_order_date
   FROM `pplk8s-lab-001.silver.orders`
   GROUP BY customer_id),
     cohort_conversion AS
  (SELECT c.customer_id,
          c.signup_date,
          fo.first_order_date,
          CASE
              WHEN fo.first_order_date IS NOT NULL
                   AND DATE_DIFF(fo.first_order_date, c.signup_date, DAY) >= 0
                   AND DATE_DIFF(fo.first_order_date, c.signup_date, DAY) < 30 THEN 1
              ELSE 0
          END AS converted_30d
   FROM sep_cohort AS c
   LEFT JOIN first_orders AS fo ON c.customer_id = fo.customer_id)
SELECT COUNT(*) AS total_signups,
       SUM(converted_30d) AS converted_customers,
       ROUND(SAFE_DIVIDE(SUM(converted_30d), COUNT(*)) * 100, 2) AS signup_to_first_order_rate_percentage,
       SAFE_DIVIDE(SUM(converted_30d), COUNT(*)) AS signup_to_first_order_ratio
FROM cohort_conversion;

turns.text: Between 1 and 10 October 2026, repeat customers accounted for 86.57% of total revenue (€1,850.34 out of €2,137.34 in non-cancelled orders).

args.sql:
WITH customer_order_counts AS
  (SELECT customer_id,
          COUNT(order_id) AS total_orders_all_time
   FROM `pplk8s-lab-001.silver.orders`
   GROUP BY customer_id),
     period_orders AS
  (SELECT o.order_id,
          o.customer_id,
          o.amount,
          o.status,
          COALESCE(coc.total_orders_all_time, 0) AS total_orders_all_time
   FROM `pplk8s-lab-001.silver.orders` AS o
   LEFT JOIN customer_order_counts AS coc ON o.customer_id = coc.customer_id
   WHERE o.order_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-10-01' AND DATE '2026-10-10'
     AND LOWER(o.status) != 'cancelled' )
SELECT SUM(CASE
               WHEN total_orders_all_time >= 2 THEN amount
               ELSE 0
           END) AS repeat_customer_revenue_eur,
       SUM(amount) AS total_revenue_eur,
       ROUND(SAFE_DIVIDE(SUM(CASE
                                 WHEN total_orders_all_time >= 2 THEN amount
                                 ELSE 0
                             END), SUM(amount)) * 100, 2) AS repeat_customer_revenue_share_pct
FROM period_orders;

WITH search_campaigns AS
  (SELECT campaign_id,
          name,
          channel
   FROM `pplk8s-lab-001.silver.campaigns`
   WHERE LOWER(channel) = 'search' ),
     spend_data AS
  (SELECT s.spend_date,
          s.campaign_id,
          s.spend
   FROM `pplk8s-lab-001.silver.ad_spend` s
   JOIN search_campaigns c ON s.campaign_id = c.campaign_id
   WHERE s.spend_date >= '2026-10-01'
     AND s.spend_date <= '2026-10-15' ),
     lead_data AS

       SAFE_DIVIDE(COALESCE(SUM(s.spend), 0),
                     (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT lead_id)

turns.text: Revenue in the week starting Monday, 14 September 2026 grew by **32.65%** compared to the week before, increasing from €2,340.50 to €3,104.75 based on the Revenue week-over-week growth metric definition.

args.sql:
WITH weekly_revenue AS
  (SELECT DATE_TRUNC(order_date, WEEK(MONDAY)) AS week_start,
          SUM(amount) AS revenue
   FROM `pplk8s-lab-001.silver.orders`
   WHERE status != 'cancelled'
     AND order_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-09-07' AND DATE '2026-09-20'
   GROUP BY week_start)
SELECT curr.week_start AS current_week,
       curr.revenue AS current_week_revenue,
       prev.week_start AS previous_week,
       prev.revenue AS previous_week_revenue,
       ROUND(SAFE_DIVIDE(curr.revenue - prev.revenue, prev.revenue) * 100, 2) AS revenue_growth_percentage
FROM weekly_revenue curr
LEFT JOIN weekly_revenue prev ON prev.week_start = DATE_SUB(curr.week_start, INTERVAL 1 WEEK)
WHERE curr.week_start = DATE '2026-09-14';

turns.text: In the week of 14 September 2026 (starting Monday, 2026-09-14), bookings increased by **3** (from **11** to **14**), representing a week-over-week growth of **27.3%** (or **+20.7%** in total booking value from €27,500 to €33,200). ### Weekly Booking Growth Highlights - **Bookings Count**: Grew from **11** in the previous week (7–13 Sep) to **14** in the week of 14 Sep (+27.3%). - **Booking Value**: Rose by **€5,700** (+20.7%), increasing from **€27,500** to **€33,200**.

args.sql:
WITH weekly_bookings AS
  (SELECT DATE_TRUNC(booked_date, WEEK(MONDAY)) AS week_start_date,
          COUNT(booking_id) AS bookings,
          SUM(amount) AS booking_value_eur
   FROM `pplk8s-lab-001.silver.bookings`
   WHERE booked_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-09-07' AND DATE '2026-09-20'
   GROUP BY week_start_date),
     growth_calc AS
  (SELECT week_start_date,
          bookings,
          booking_value_eur,
          LAG(bookings) OVER (
                              ORDER BY week_start_date) AS prev_week_bookings,
                             LAG(booking_value_eur) OVER (
                                                          ORDER BY week_start_date) AS prev_week_booking_value_eur
   FROM weekly_bookings)
SELECT week_start_date,
       bookings,
       prev_week_bookings,
       bookings - prev_week_bookings AS bookings_change,
       ROUND(SAFE_DIVIDE(bookings - prev_week_bookings, prev_week_bookings) * 100, 1) AS bookings_growth_pct,
       booking_value_eur,
       prev_week_booking_value_eur,
       booking_value_eur - prev_week_booking_value_eur AS booking_value_change_eur,
       ROUND(SAFE_DIVIDE(booking_value_eur - prev_week_booking_value_eur, prev_week_booking_value_eur) * 100, 1) AS booking_value_growth_pct
FROM growth_calc
WHERE week_start_date = DATE '2026-09-14'
ORDER BY week_start_date;

turns.text: For the week starting 14 September 2026, leads increased from 29 to 35, representing a week-over-week growth of **20.69%** (+6 leads).

args.sql:
WITH weekly_leads AS
  (SELECT DATE_TRUNC(created_date, WEEK(MONDAY)) AS week_start,
          COUNT(lead_id) AS leads
   FROM `pplk8s-lab-001.silver.leads`
   WHERE created_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-08-31' AND DATE '2026-09-27'

SELECT w2.week_start,

       SAFE_DIVIDE(w2.leads - w1.leads, w1.leads) AS wow_growth_ratio
FROM weekly_leads w2

WHERE w2.week_start = DATE '2026-09-14'
ORDER BY w2.week_start;

On 1 October 2026, the net revenue was **€964.19**, calculated from **€981.69** in gross revenue (non-cancelled orders) minus **€17.50** in recorded partner returns.

args.sql:
WITH revenue_cte AS
  (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(amount), 0) AS gross_revenue
   FROM `pplk8s-lab-001.silver.orders`
   WHERE order_date = DATE '2026-10-01'

turns.text: On 1 October 2026, the net revenue was **€964.19** (gross revenue of €981.69 minus €17.50 in partner returns).

args.sql:

   FROM `pplk8s-lab-001.silver.orders`
   WHERE order_date = DATE '2026-10-01'

     daily_returns AS

   FROM `pplk8s-lab-001.silver.returns`
   WHERE return_date = DATE '2026-10-01' )
SELECT daily_revenue.gross_revenue,

turns.text: The net revenue of **€964.19** for 1 October 2026 was calculated in accordance with the Net revenue (EUR) metric definition: $$\text{Net Revenue} = \text{Revenue (EUR)} - \text{Returns (EUR)}$$ ### Calculation Breakdown: 1. **Revenue (EUR)**: Sum of `amount` from non-cancelled orders (`status != 'cancelled'`) placed on `2026-10-01` in `silver.orders` = **€981.69**. 2. **Returns (EUR)**: Sum of return `amount` recorded on `2026-10-01` (`return_date = '2026-10-01'`) in `silver.returns` = **€17.50**. 3. **Net Revenue**: €981.69 − €17.50 = **€964.19**. ```sql WITH daily_revenue AS ( SELECT COALESCE(SUM(amount), 0) AS gross_revenue FROM `pplk8s-lab-001.silver.orders` WHERE order_date = DATE '2026-10-01' AND status != 'cancelled' ), daily_returns AS ( SELECT COALESCE(SUM(amount), 0) AS returns_amount FROM `pplk8s-lab-001.silver.returns` WHERE return_date = DATE '2026-10-01' ) SELECT daily_revenue.gross_revenue, daily_returns.returns_amount, daily_revenue.gross_revenue - daily_returns.returns_amount AS net_revenue FROM daily_revenue CROSS JOIN daily_returns; ```

WITH cohort_orders AS
  (SELECT o.amount,
          CASE
              WHEN c.signup_date < '2026-01-01' THEN 'Before 2026'
              WHEN EXTRACT(YEAR
                           FROM c.signup_date) = 2026 THEN 'In 2026'
              ELSE 'Other'
          END AS signup_cohort
   FROM `pplk8s-lab-001.silver.orders` AS o
   INNER JOIN `pplk8s-lab-001.silver.customers` AS c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id
   WHERE o.order_date BETWEEN '2026-08-17' AND '2026-10-10'
     AND LOWER(o.status) != 'cancelled' ),
     cohort_summary AS
  (SELECT signup_cohort,
          COUNT(*) AS order_count,
          SUM(amount) AS total_revenue_eur,
          AVG(amount) AS avg_order_value_eur
   FROM cohort_orders
   WHERE signup_cohort IN ('Before 2026',
                           'In 2026')
   GROUP BY signup_cohort)
SELECT MAX(CASE
               WHEN signup_cohort = 'Before 2026' THEN avg_order_value_eur
           END) AS avg_order_value_pre_2026_eur,
       MAX(CASE
               WHEN signup_cohort = 'In 2026' THEN avg_order_value_eur
           END) AS avg_order_value_2026_eur,
       MAX(CASE
               WHEN signup_cohort = 'Before 2026' THEN avg_order_value_eur
           END) - MAX(CASE
                          WHEN signup_cohort = 'In 2026' THEN avg_order_value_eur
                      END) AS difference_eur
FROM cohort_summary;

turns.text: The median time from the first add-to-cart to checkout for qualifying sessions between 20 September and 3 October 2026 was **4 minutes** (based on 2 sessions).

args.sql:
WITH session_events AS
  (SELECT session_id,
          MIN(CASE
                  WHEN action_type = 'add_to_cart' THEN event_ts
              END) AS first_cart_ts,
          MIN(CASE
                  WHEN action_type = 'checkout' THEN event_ts
              END) AS checkout_ts
   FROM `pplk8s-lab-001.silver.customer_actions`
   WHERE event_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-09-20' AND DATE '2026-10-03'
     AND session_id IS NOT NULL
   GROUP BY session_id
   HAVING first_cart_ts IS NOT NULL
   AND checkout_ts IS NOT NULL
   AND checkout_ts >= first_cart_ts),
     session_diffs AS
  (SELECT session_id,
          TIMESTAMP_DIFF(checkout_ts, first_cart_ts, MINUTE) AS diff_minutes,
          TIMESTAMP_DIFF(checkout_ts, first_cart_ts, SECOND) / 60.0 AS diff_minutes_exact
   FROM session_events)
SELECT
  (SELECT COUNT(*)
   FROM session_diffs) AS qualifying_sessions,
       APPROX_QUANTILES(diff_minutes, 100)[OFFSET(50)] AS median_minutes_int,
       APPROX_QUANTILES(diff_minutes_exact, 100)[OFFSET(50)] AS median_minutes_exact
FROM session_diffs

turns.text: Revenue in the week starting Monday, September 14, 2026 grew by **32.65%** compared to the prior week. - **Previous Week (Sep 07 – Sep 13, 2026) Revenue:** €2,340.50 - **Current Week (Sep 14 – Sep 20, 2026) Revenue:** €3,104.75 - **Absolute Revenue Increase:** €764.25 (+32.65%)

args.sql:
WITH weekly_revenue AS
  (SELECT DATE_TRUNC(order_date, WEEK(MONDAY)) AS week_start,
          SUM(amount) AS revenue
   FROM `pplk8s-lab-001.silver.orders`
   WHERE LOWER(status) != 'cancelled'
     AND order_date >= DATE '2026-09-07'
     AND order_date <= DATE '2026-09-20'
   GROUP BY week_start)
SELECT prev.revenue AS previous_week_revenue,
       curr.revenue AS current_week_revenue,
       curr.revenue - prev.revenue AS revenue_change,
       ROUND(SAFE_DIVIDE(curr.revenue - prev.revenue, prev.revenue) * 100, 2) AS growth_percentage
FROM
  (SELECT revenue
   FROM weekly_revenue
   WHERE week_start = DATE '2026-09-14') curr
CROSS JOIN
  (SELECT revenue
   FROM weekly_revenue
   WHERE week_start = DATE '2026-09-07') prev

   FROM weekly_bookings)

WITH session_durations AS

                COUNT(*) OVER() AS total_sessions
FROM session_durations

            OR LOWER(app.current_stage) IN ('interview', 'offer', 'hired')) AS reached_interview_or_beyond
   FROM `pplk8s-lab-001.silver.applications` AS app
   LEFT JOIN `pplk8s-lab-001.silver.candidate_stages` AS cs ON app.candidate_id = cs.candidate_id
   WHERE app.applied_date BETWEEN '2026-09-01' AND '2026-09-30'
   GROUP BY app.candidate_id,
            app.applied_date,
            app.current_stage)
SELECT COUNT(*) AS total_applicants,
       COUNTIF(reached_interview_or_beyond) AS applicants_reached_interview_or_beyond,
       ROUND(SAFE_DIVIDE(COUNTIF(reached_interview_or_beyond), COUNT(*)) * 100, 2) AS share_percentage
FROM sept_applicants;

turns.text: Between 17 August and 10 October 2026, the average non-cancelled order amount for customers who signed up before 2026 was **€102.67**, compared to **€41.00** for customers who signed up in 2026 (2026 signup cohort). This represents a difference of **€61.67** (or approximately €61.67 higher for pre-2026 signups).

args.sql:
WITH order_cohorts AS
  (SELECT orders.order_id,
          orders.amount,
          customers.signup_date,
          CASE
              WHEN customers.signup_date < '2026-01-01' THEN 'Before 2026'
              WHEN EXTRACT(YEAR
                           FROM customers.signup_date) = 2026 THEN 'In 2026'
              ELSE 'Other'
          END AS signup_cohort
   FROM `pplk8s-lab-001.silver.orders` AS orders
   INNER JOIN `pplk8s-lab-001.silver.customers` AS customers ON orders.customer_id = customers.customer_id
   WHERE orders.order_date BETWEEN '2026-08-17' AND '2026-10-10'
     AND LOWER(orders.status) != 'cancelled' ),
     cohort_summary AS
  (SELECT signup_cohort,
          COUNT(order_id) AS order_count,
          SUM(amount) AS total_revenue,
          AVG(amount) AS avg_order_amount
   FROM order_cohorts
   GROUP BY signup_cohort)
SELECT signup_cohort,
       order_count,
       total_revenue,
       avg_order_amount,
       avg_order_amount - LAG(avg_order_amount) OVER (
                                                      ORDER BY signup_cohort DESC) AS difference_eur
FROM cohort_summary
ORDER BY signup_cohort;

SELECT ROUND(AVG(CASE
                     WHEN customers.signup_date < '2026-01-01' THEN orders.amount
                 END), 2) AS avg_amount_signed_up_before_2026_eur,
       ROUND(AVG(CASE
                     WHEN EXTRACT(YEAR
                                  FROM customers.signup_date) = 2026 THEN orders.amount
                 END), 2) AS avg_amount_signed_up_in_2026_eur,
       ROUND(AVG(CASE
                     WHEN customers.signup_date < '2026-01-01' THEN orders.amount
                 END) - AVG(CASE
                                WHEN EXTRACT(YEAR
                                             FROM customers.signup_date) = 2026 THEN orders.amount
                            END), 2) AS difference_eur
FROM `pplk8s-lab-001.silver.orders` AS orders
INNER JOIN `pplk8s-lab-001.silver.customers` AS customers ON orders.customer_id = customers.customer_id
WHERE orders.order_date BETWEEN '2026-08-17' AND '2026-10-10'
  AND LOWER(orders.status) != 'cancelled';
